item.title: Trovata adds autonomous AI agents to its treasury operating system
item.description:
Trovata adds autonomous AI agents to its treasury operating system

Trovata has upgraded its AI‑native cash and liquidity management platform with autonomous agents that can act on behalf of treasury teams.

🔍 Overview

  • AI‑native cash and liquidity management platform with direct connections to over 10,000 banks from a single cloud‑based system.
  • In 2023, Trovata launched the first generative AI built specifically for treasury.
  • Latest AI‑native updates shift from delivering static insights to deploying autonomous agents that operate continuously for treasury teams.
  • The AI is embedded directly into the treasury operating system, not a generic chatbot layered on top.

🧩 How it works

  • Autonomous treasury agents run on schedules, triggers, or rules to monitor activity, explain variance, detect anomalies, and deliver updates automatically.
  • Agents are built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, a secure, isolated environment purpose‑built for enterprise AI.
  • When a user asks a question, the AI retrieves data through Trovata’s verified API layer, analyzes it, and returns the response within the same secure infrastructure.
  • Users can query bank data in plain English via natural‑language querying.

⚙️ Architecture

Component Role
Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Secure, isolated environment for autonomous agents
AI Insights Automated anomaly detection, variance explanation, and trend analysis
Agent Builder‑Configurator Management console for building and configuring treasury agents
Enterprise RBAC Role‑based access control that keeps agents within the same permission boundaries as human users
Direct bank connections Provides cash reporting, forecasting, analysis, and money movement across 10,000+ banks

💡 Impact

  • $1M+ in annualized cost savings for customers.
  • >5 hours per day saved per accounting team.
  • 77 % reduction in annual Treasury Management System (TMS) costs.
  • Treasury reporting time reduced from hours or days to under a minute.
  • Cash forecasting is now automated across multi‑bank environments with scenario modeling, replacing manual spreadsheet‑based projections.
  • Real‑time anomaly detection identifies unusual transactions, balance changes, or cash‑flow patterns that could indicate errors, fraud, or operational issues.

#Trovata #AIAgents #TreasuryManagement #EnterpriseAI

Source: Autonomous treasury agents: How Trovata built an AI-native solution on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore | Amazon Web Services

item.title: BMW Group Implements AI-Driven Anomaly Detection for Cloud FinOps
item.description:
BMW Group Implements AI-Driven Anomaly Detection for Cloud FinOps

The BMW Group has developed Cloud Efficiency Analytics (CLEA), an in-house FinOps system built on AWS in collaboration with Reply, to monitor spending across more than 14,000 cloud accounts.

🧩 How it works

CLEA uses Meta’s open source forecasting library, Prophet, to establish cost baselines for account-service pairs. The system operates as follows:

  • Training: Models are trained on 365 days of daily cost history per account-service pair using additive seasonality.
  • Orchestration: AWS Step Functions triggers a daily run once AWS CUR delivery is confirmed. A Distributed Map process fans work out across up to 500 concurrent Lambda functions.
  • Detection: The system flags anomalies when actual costs fall outside the confidence intervals produced by the Prophet model.
  • Thresholds: Anomalies must deviate by at least 40% from expected spend. Generic and case-specific thresholds ensure alerts are only triggered when both deviation and minimum dollar impact criteria are met.

⚙️ Key details

Feature Description
Scope Over 14,000 cloud accounts and hundreds of thousands of account-service combinations.
Performance Full run for 14,000 accounts completes in approximately 20 minutes.
Exclusions Low-spend services (averaging below $0.10 over 3 days) and services with fewer than 10 days of history are excluded.
Output 12-month rolling forecast and daily predicted values for anomaly detection.

💡 Why it matters

By learning the specific trajectory of each account-service pair, CLEA enables comparison against historical behavior rather than centrally chosen metrics. This automated pipeline proactively sends email notifications to account owners whenever spending patterns deviate from expected levels.

#AWS #FinOps #BMW #Prophet #CloudComputing

Source: How BMW Group detects cost anomalies across 14,000 cloud accounts | Amazon Web Services
